items.question: How is consulting different from an agency?
items.answer: Agencies report clicks and impressions. We work on lead quality, acquisition cost and ROI. We answer why and what first, then manage the agencies.

items.question: How do you help Turkish B2B companies enter the UK?
items.answer: Through cultural adaptation and local trust: a British tone of voice, soft power on LinkedIn to reach decision makers, and the image of a reliable local partner.

items.question: How long until we see results?
items.answer: Usually three to six months. Engagement grows from month one, qualified leads arrive from month three, and closed revenue from month six.

items.question: We have no CRM. Should we set one up first?
items.answer: No. We map your sales process first, then choose and set up the simplest CRM that fits, such as HubSpot, Salesforce or Zoho.

items.question: Is this right for SMEs?
items.answer: Yes. SMEs cannot afford trial and error. You get the tools large companies use, such as personas, ABM and content strategy, sized to your budget.
